candidates.change_summary: Delete the statement `credit[msg.sender]=0;` so credit is not cleared after withdrawal, allowing repeated withdrawals that deduct and pay out again.
Change the guard from `oCredit>0` to `oCredit>=0` so the withdrawal branch executes even when the caller has zero credit.
Move `credit[msg.sender]=0;` before the external call, changing behavior under reentrancy since the caller's credit is already zero during the callback.
Delete `__lock_modifier0_lock = true;` so the mutex is never set, disabling the reentrancy guard.
Delete `__lock_modifier0_lock = false;` so the lock is never released, causing any second call to withdrawAll to revert.
